description: attribute base set, modifiers (add, value get, remove) and the full saved data of a pig with a chicken passenger (Brain, attributes, impulse fields, Passengers); results stored into a probe chest.

actions.command: item replace block 0 -60 0 container.0 with minecraft:paper
execute store result storage t:p a3 int 1 run attribute @e[tag=p,limit=1] minecraft:max_health base set 20
execute store result storage t:p a4 int 1 run attribute @e[tag=p,limit=1] minecraft:movement_speed modifier add t:m 0.5 add_multiplied_total
execute store success storage t:p a5 int 1 run attribute @e[tag=p,limit=1] minecraft:movement_speed modifier add t:m 0.5 add_value
execute store result storage t:p a6 int 1 run attribute @e[tag=p,limit=1] minecraft:movement_speed get 1000
execute store result storage t:p a7 int 1 run attribute @e[tag=p,limit=1] minecraft:movement_speed modifier value get t:m 100
execute store result storage t:p a8 int 1 run attribute @e[tag=p,limit=1] minecraft:movement_speed modifier remove t:m
execute store result storage t:p aa int 1 run attribute @e[tag=p,limit=1] minecraft:scale base set 1.5
data modify storage t:p pig set from entity @e[tag=p,limit=1] {}
data modify block 0 -60 0 Items[0].components."minecraft:custom_data" set from storage t:p
